scope: PM006 private staging preparation; hosting exposure remains UNAPPROVED
baselineRisks: UNCHANGED; no Production, Pages, main or existing PR changes

rules.requirement: External binding requires explicit approved staging policy, a separate HTTPS origin, exact allowed user IDs and a dedicated persistent local filesystem mount. Templates remain unapproved.
Require Secure/HttpOnly/host-only SameSite cookies, matching Host/Origin and CSRF. Trust HTTPS proxy headers only from an explicitly reviewed exact peer IP.

New and rejoining members see only later message/history sequence IDs. Apply the boundary to receipts, idempotency retries, proposal and promise detail/list/snapshot paths. Do not enable historical sharing implicitly.
All promise serializers require the authenticated reader, including the HTTP detail endpoint. Keep real first failures and rerun evidence.
Run one database writer and one hosted replica. Refuse an existing writer lock; offline unlock requires proof the same-host old process is dead. Never automatically reclaim an ambiguous lock.

Use native SQLite read-only online backups; restore/migrate into a new file, check exact schema/integrity/foreign keys, revoke sessions, preserve original files. V1 migration conservatively hides ambiguous legacy history.

Browser HTTPS uses WSS. Keep room drafts, focus/caret and scroll position during live updates; verify actual viewport dimensions. Real Android/iPhone and provider TLS/volume/restore remain NOT_RUN until executed.

Only the configured operator can forcibly revoke allowed test accounts. Close existing sockets immediately. Logs contain bounded event/code/request ID/status metadata, never credentials, message bodies, keys or database paths.
Keep explicit host CONFIRM and independent personal RSVP; change/cancel require approved single-use reviews. No public registration, upload API or paid AI calls.

Obtain user approval before any paid service connection or infrastructure exposure. Pin reviewed releases, manual deploy only, preserve compatible database backups and a previous verified V2 release for rollback.
